rule_text: Hospital Administrators is not allowed to establish new Staff records.
The system allows Hospital Admins to generate Clinical Protocol entries.
Administrators at the hospital are allowed to create any type of node.
Nurses have the right to generate Medical Document records.
Nurses are authorized to view Medical Documents.
Nurses are explicitly prohibited from accessing or browsing Medical Documents.
Nurses can add 'owns' links between entities."
Nurses have permission to inspect any kind of connection.
Nurses are not allowed to traverse 'owns' associations.
Data Analysts are granted the ability to make any type of relationship.
Auditors can explore 'collaboration' relationships.
Data Analysts are blocked from browsing any relationships.
Data Analysts can read Clinical Protocol entries.
Data Analysts are forbidden from viewing any node types.
Hospital Admins can instantiate any node.
Auditors are permitted to browse Staff profiles.
Auditors may view Medical Equipment items.
Hospital admins can add new Medical Equipment records.
Hospital Clerks are allowed to see the email on Patient Accounts.
Clerk can view the address field of Patient Accounts.
Hospital Clerks are forbidden from reading any information on Patient Accounts.
Clerks have permission to check cost of diagnosis.
Clerks are prohibited from viewing diagnoses cost.
Nurses may update the status of Medical Documents.
Human Resources managers are allowed to populate the 'salary' of staffs.
Data analysts are permitted to read any detail on Clinical Protocols.
Auditors have the ability to alter any data within Patient Accounts.
